name: v10-keys

checks.id: K1a the motion notice is the first thing, and the card is not up with it
K1b the Controls dialog "How will you fly?" is up after the scan is ready, with no card on it
K1 a first-time visitor who chose Keyboard meets the card after the scan is ready
K1c the card waited for the choice: it was not up while the Controls dialog was still up (2 s later), and it came after Keyboard was chosen
K2 the card shows SPACE = UP and SHIFT = DOWN as the two big keys (arrow and word with each), hold to land

detail.downSub: hold to descend, and to land

checks.id: K2b the rest of the game scheme is on it: mouse, W A S D, turn keys, F full screen, Esc pause, R, N next scene, K this card
K3 accessibility: a modal dialog named by its title, the focus is on Start flying, Tab stays inside the card
K3b five Tab presses never leave the card (x, Start, the box, round again)
K4 every text on the card is at least WCAG AA against the lightest scene behind it (>= 4.5:1)
K5 the flight is held while the card is up, and flying keys do nothing under it (W held 0.6 s: not armed, not moved)
K6 Start flying closes the card, resumes the flight and captures the mouse (pointer lock)
K7 the first key after the start takes off: Space climbs (the drone is armed and higher than at the start)
K8 for the first seconds of the first flight a small pill says "Space up . Shift down"
K8b the pill names both caps and both words
K9 the corner line in flight starts with Space up / Shift down (before: K keys, F, R, Esc, H)

detail.corner: crashes 0  ·  Space up · Shift down · K keys · F full screen · R respawn · Esc pause · H hide text

checks.id: K8c the pill was up and goes at once when Shift is pressed
K10 across the whole first visit the card was up and never together with another dialog (Controls, the motion notice, a panel, the menu, the picker, the crash panel)
K10c (control of the sampler) a dialog put up under the card is counted by the overlap sampler
K11 a second visit (nothing ticked) shows the card again, by itself: no Controls dialog this time, the keyboard of last time is back
K11b the box is not ticked on the second visit (nothing was ticked in the first)
K13 the pill lasts the first seconds only: up at 2 s, gone by 10 s, with W held from take-off (key repeats do not hide it)
K12 ticking "Do not show again" writes the setting at once (input.howToFly off), and closing with x keeps it
K12b the tick survives closing with x
K14 after "Do not show again" a reload does not bring the card back (4.5 s after the scene is ready)
K14b after "Do not show again" the first-flight pill does not show either (the drone is flying)
K15 K opens the card again, whatever the setting says; its box shows the setting (ticked)
K15b K again closes it and the flight goes on (not paused)
K15c Esc closes the card (and does not open the pause menu on top)
K16 the pause menu has a "How to fly" item with its key K beside it
K16b picking it shows the card (over nothing: the menu is gone), opened from the menu
K16c with the menu up, K runs the item: the card opens and the menu is gone
K17 for a radio or gamepad the card is the short radio one: sticks, arm, mode switch, N, Esc, K
K18 in visits 2 and 3 as well the card came and was never up together with another dialog
K19 on a phone (touch, no WebHID) the card is the touch one: the two pads, no key caps, "touch a stick to take off"
K19b it fits the phone: inside the screen, Start flying reachable
K19c tapping Start flying closes it and leaves the touch sticks to fly
K19d it did not stand over the motion notice or another dialog on the phone either
K20 closing Controls with x also ends at the card (the keyboard stands in), and in a 900 x 480 window the Space and Shift keys are fully on screen
K20b Start flying is reachable in that window: on the screen, or the card scrolls
K24 phone-landscape (en, 812 x 375): the touch card is up, inside the screen, no sideways scroll, nothing sticks out, Start flying reachable (on the screen or the card scrolls)
K24 phone-ru (ru, 390 x 844): the touch card is up, inside the screen, no sideways scroll, nothing sticks out, Start flying reachable (on the screen or the card scrolls)
K24 short-pl (pl, 900 x 480): the game card is up, inside the screen, no sideways scroll, nothing sticks out, Start flying reachable (on the screen or the card scrolls), Space in the page's own word

K24 desktop-es (es, 1280 x 800): the game card is up, inside the screen, no sideways scroll, nothing sticks out, Start flying reachable (on the screen or the card scrolls), Space in the page's own word
K21 on a ?nowarn=1 page (the page every older bench uses) the card never opens by itself, the keyboard flies as before
K22 with the pilot profile the ground card of the pilot keyboard is still up (arm steps, the Mode 2 keys)
K21b K still opens it there
K23 for the pilot keyboard the card is the pilot one: Space arms, W / S throttle, A / D yaw, the arrows tilt, M mode, then R, Esc, N, K; no Space / Shift pair
